mentions.name: Deviceterm
mentions.description: A macOS terminal (built as a libghostty wrapper) that runs iOS simulators and mirrored physical devices in a Metal-rendered pane inside the terminal. It integrates with standard tooling—e.g., anything in a tab that runs `xcrun simctl boot` causes the simulator to appear as a pane in that tab—and includes a CLI covering capabilities simctl/devicectl lack, such as taps, gestures, rotation, and the accessibility tree.
